Method of Attack: Hiding malicious code inside the metadata fields of images hosted on Google's official CDN (googleusercontent.com)
Malicious code hidden in the 'UserComment' EXIF metadata field of images
Base64-encoded script that uploads a predefined web shell on compromised servers
Web shell used for defacing servers and emailing exploited site addresses to attacker
Attack Vector: Malicious images uploaded to GoogleUserContent CDN
EXIF metadata field exploitation in images
Indicators of Compromise: Images hosted on googleusercontent.com with malicious 'UserComment' EXIF metadata field
